trigger_condition: Stored custom dashboard has id exactly equal to 'adoption'
potential_consequence: User-created custom dashboard with id='adoption' permanently redirected to insights tab

trigger_condition: User revisits or bookmarks URL containing notice=adoption-retired
guard_snippet: Add dismiss button: onClick={() => setSearchParams({ tab }, { replace: true })}
potential_consequence: Retirement notice displayed indefinitely with no user affordance to clear it

trigger_condition: Direct navigation to custom dashboard URL before loadDashboards resolves
guard_snippet: Track dashboardsLoaded flag; defer isCustomDashboard evaluation until flag is true
potential_consequence: Edit Dashboard button absent on initial render then flashes in after async load

trigger_condition: Screen-reader user is redirected from tab=adoption to insights
potential_consequence: Retirement notice never announced to assistive-technology users

trigger_condition: clearState() called while dashboards are loaded (e.g. future logout path)
guard_snippet: Call loadDashboards() after clearState(), or document that dashboards must be reloaded
potential_consequence: dashboards resets to [] — was never cleared before; custom tabs disappear until reload
